query:
SELECT 'orders' as tbl, COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='pending_payment' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_payment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus IN ('paid','paid_held','payment_received','processing') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as paid,
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus IN ('shipped','delivered','completed') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as shipped_done,
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cancelled,
  SUM(CASE WHEN orderStatus IN ('disputed','refunded') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as disputed
FROM marketplaceOrders
UNION ALL
SELECT 'sellers', COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN isActive=1 AND isSuspended=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN isSuspended=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN stripeConnectStatus='active' OR stripeConnectStatus='verified' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN stripeConnectStatus='not_started' OR stripeConnectStatus='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  0
FROM sellerProfiles
UNION ALL
SELECT 'cartItems', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM cartItems
UNION ALL
SELECT 'offers', COUNT(*),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='accepted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='rejected' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('cancelled','expired') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
  0
FROM offers;
